run_replay_stats: run replay_actions.py to dump stats about all actions used in a set of StarCraft II replays
create_replay_stats: create a ReplayStats object to accumulate and merge summary statistics across multiple replay files
merge_replay_stats: merge two ReplayStats objects to combine statistics from parallel replay processing workers
process_replay: process a single StarCraft II replay file to collect action, ability, unit, buff, and upgrade statistics
validate_replay: validate a replay file by checking for corruption, game version match, duration, player count, APM, and MMR
